reconcile.note: Keil and Delitzsch argue Genesis 2 simply retells day six in closer focus, reading its verb for the animals as a pluperfect so no rival sequence exists.

sides.snippet: God created man in his own image. In God's image he created him; male and female he created them.
sides.verseText: God created man in his own image. In God's image he created him; male and female he created them.

sides.snippet: He made the rib, which Yahweh God had taken from the man, into a woman, and brought her to the man.
sides.verseText: He made the rib, which Yahweh God had taken from the man, into a woman, and brought her to the man.
